cases.description: Checklist item 5 context (real run timing shouldn't be trusted blindly) applies in reverse here: with --dry-run, both steps report PENDING and no step output file is ever written, confirming the plan compiles (registry lookup + compatibility check) without spawning a single subprocess — useful for validating a template/task pairing cheaply before committing to a real, timed run.
cases.grounding: step_runner.run_step returns StepStatus.PENDING immediately when dry_run is True, before subprocess.run is ever called; verified no files exist under the case's out_dir after the run.
